verdict.rationale: Pomelo's guides document creating users and validating their identity so they can operate (pomelo-docs-1). This is a first-party identity-verification capability tied to cardholder onboarding, and it sits alongside nominated card issuance (pomelo-docs-2, pomelo-docs-24). The evidence is a single thin mention, though, with no detail on how verification works. Missing for 10: KYB for business cardholders, documented KYC data/document requirements, review states (pending/approved/rejected), re-verification or refresh flows, verification status webhooks, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
